results.description: Certificate of Interested Entities by FCA US, LLC FCA US, LLC is a limited liability company whose sole member is FCA North America Holdings, LLC. The sole member of FCA North America Holdings, LLC is Fiat Chrysler Automobiles N.V. Fiat Chrysler Automobiles N.V. is a publicly traded corporation organized and existing under the laws of The Netherlands, with its principal place of business in London. Neither FCA US, LLC, nor FCA North America Holdings, LLC, nor Fiat Chrysler Automobiles N.V. is a citizen of California. (Wolf, Matthew) (Filed on 1/10/2025) (Entered: 01/10/2025)
